title: Unnai Thedi
desc: Raghu travels to New Zealand with a friend and meets Malavika, whom he falls in love with. However, circumstances force them to part ways.

title: Veetla Visheshanga
desc: A widower helps a woman by admitting her to the hospital. However, complications arise when the doctor convinces her that he is her husband.

title: Singaravelan
desc: Velan's mother tells him to find his cousin, Sumathi, who lives in the city and marry her. Velan sets out to find her with the help of a childhood photograph.

title: Medhai
desc: A school teacher, wrongly accused of embezzling money from a public trust, sets out on a path of revenge after learning about the events that led to his imprisonment.

title: Mazhai
desc: Two men, a jobless guy and a powerful don, fall for the same girl on a rainy day at a railway station, sparking a tense rivalry.
